narrative.intro: Axiom Space has $213M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Axiom Space has 7 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $30.4M, and obligations are up 62.7% year over year. Fiscal-year history shows obligations rising from $1.7M in FY21 to $213M in FY26. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration obligated $213M to Axiom Space in FY2026 to date, while the Department of Defense obligated $500. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest NAICS market for Axiom Space at $211M, followed by Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences at $1.7M. Current-year totals are partial because the period is FY2026 to date. Use these figures to prioritize outreach to NASA and to highlight capabilities in guided missile and space vehicle manufacturing when discussing Axiom Space with government buyers or partners.

sections.heading: Who are Axiom Space's top government customers?
sections.body: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration is the top customer, obligating $213M to Axiom Space in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense is a secondary buyer, obligating $500. Focus on NASA for the bulk of current federal work.

sections.heading: What markets and work does Axiom Space perform for the government?
sections.body: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the primary market for Axiom Space at $211M. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences accounts for $1.7M in obligations, indicating some R&D work alongside manufacturing.

faq.q: How much does Axiom Space make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Axiom Space has $213M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Axiom Space has received 7 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $30.4M, and obligations are up 62.7% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Axiom Space?
faq.a: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration buys the most from Axiom Space, obligating $213M in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense also buys from Axiom Space, obligating $500 in the same period.

faq.q: What does Axiom Space sell to the government?
faq.a: Axiom Space sells guided missile and space vehicle manufacturing services to the government, with obligations of $211M in that NAICS market. Axiom Space also performs research and development in the physical, engineering, and life sciences, with $1.7M in obligations.
